text_block_list.text: On the way back from our outing, Yamanin Zephyr murmured that she wanted to feel the wind, so we came to a hilltop. Up there—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! It's Zephyr and her trainer!
Hey, heyーー!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my. What a pleasant breeze. Are the two of you here to feel the wind as well?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
'Sup.
Just getting a little change of pace, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, there was this Twin Turbo girl
who got an utterly absurd score on a pop quiz."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature was helping me study!!
We're taking a break right now~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: What about you? On a walk? Wanna play with Turbo and the gang?!
choice_data_list: We don't really have time to be playing around...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What a little whirlwind.
A little bundle of energy, always so prickly.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Poke?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, break time's over.
Pouty Turbo, back to studying for you."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Poke-Turbo!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The make-up exam is tomorrow,
so you've gotta review one more time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Just a passing breeze, I won't get in your way.
We'll head over that way—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... Studied enough!
Turbo worked super hard, so now I wanna play!
Zephyr, everyone, let's play!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hopping and begging.
Was Mr. Pokey a round one, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Roundy"... did that mean sparrows?
Sigh. Well, there's no way she'll be able to concentrate like this anyway, so it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What should we play, Little Spiky?
Tag? Singing? Or something else?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's not Miss Pokey, it's Twin Turbo!
Ummm, well... what should we do?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You can take all the tiiime you need to think about it.
The wind is very gentle right now, after all.

Yamanin Zephyr always keeps her own pace,
but somehow, when it comes to Twin Turbo—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, it is heartwarming, but...
She's totally treating me like a small animal, isn't she...?
Though spoken in the kind of tone one uses with animals, Twin Turbo didn't seem to mind at all and looked genuinely happy.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hard to decide~! Zephyr likes the wind, so maybe kite flying? But we don't have a kite!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I could become the wind, I cannot become a kite.
Trainer, do you have any good ideas?"
"For Yamanin Zephyr to bring up a conversation like this is truly rare."

She came to me for help, so I must think carefully and give her a proper answer.
If there is no kite—

She came to me for help, so I must think carefully and give her a proper answer.
If there is no kite—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer is a kite?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr's Trainer is amazing!!
Turbo wants to be one too!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, as if I could!
Geez, don't say weird things just because you got carried away.

I panicked and said something totally bizarre.
Did I just make myself look
even more unreliable?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If I become the evening gale,
perhaps I might be able to lift you
right into the sky, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's not bad either.
Yamanin Zephyr chuckles softly. She speaks this way precisely because she yearns to be strong and fast—just like the wind, but still...
choice_data_list: Let's skip floating in the air...

text_block_list.text: Even if Yamanin Zephyr wished to become the wind, I decided I'd pass on being flown up into the sky like a kite.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's just that much...?
But wouldn't it be bad if it headed toward town?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If we don't find it, it'll just become trash.
And if it falls into the street, it could be danger—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In the evening breeze, turning from white to orange...
Your paper airplane is flying so beautifully, Pokey-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! You launched it already?! Where?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Look over there! Turbo's paper airplane has turbojets attached,
so it flies super duper fast—!!

Bathed in the sunset glow,
letters faintly came into view.
That's—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, you're right!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's the assignment where you have to fix the mistakes and resubmit it...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Drifting left and right, on and on without end.
The wind simply cannot be captured, can it?
The rustling leaves must be having fun playing along.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Don't just stand there laughing, help me collect them, collect them~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aah, it's too high, too high! I can't reach~!

Together with Nice Nature and Twin Turbo,
I hurried after them.

Yamanin Zephyr watched on with a gentle gaze
as the paper airplane flew, tracing the currents of the wind.
